name: Godawari Power & Ispat Ltd (GPIL)
tagline: Almost debt-free, vertically integrated iron-ore-to-steel producer with solid ROCE/ROE and above-industry revenue growth
business_overview: Godawari Power & Ispat is engaged in iron ore mining and manufacturing of iron ore pellets, sponge iron, steel billets, wire rods, HB wire, and ferro alloys, with captive electricity generation.
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely solid quality metrics — ROCE of 20.4% and ROE of 15.2% are well above what most commodity/steel names post, with an almost debt-free balance sheet and revenue growth (10.94% CAGR) beating the industry median. Vertical integration (captive iron ore mining through finished steel products) supports margin durability better than a pure steel-price play.
